title: Meridian Cloud to acquire Vireo Analytics for $1.2 billion
author: Daniel Osei
text:
Meridian Cloud has agreed to acquire Vireo Analytics for $1.2 billion in cash, the hyperscale cloud provider said on Thursday, adding a fast-growing observability business to its portfolio of developer tools.

Vireo, founded in 2019, sells software that tracks the performance, cost and reliability of applications and AI workloads running across multiple clouds. It says it has about 2,300 paying customers, including a large share of companies that run on rival platforms.

Meridian said Vireo would continue to support other clouds after the deal closes, which it expects in the first half of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions. Vireo's roughly 900 employees will join Meridian's developer platform division.

"Customers told us they cannot manage what they cannot see, especially as AI inference costs climb," said Tomas Ekberg, president of Meridian Cloud's platform business. "Vireo gives them that visibility on any cloud."

The price represents about 11 times Vireo's annual recurring sales, according to people familiar with the terms. Vireo, which is privately held, had taken about $260 million from venture investors before agreeing to the sale.
